label: PD-Lambda-3 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a PD-Lambda-3 locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model, PD-Lambda-3__PD-Lambda-3_A and PD-Lambda-3__PD-Lambda-3_B, and experimentally linked to LambdaVir protection when expressed in E. coli.
observations: PD-Lambda-3 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual PD-Lambda-3 genes and proteins, the DefenseFinder PD-Lambda-3__PD-Lambda-3_A and PD-Lambda-3__PD-Lambda-3_B profiles, the PD-Lambda-3 source key, phage protection outside a complete PD-Lambda-3 locus, RefSeq example loci without experimental validation, sibling PD-Lambda systems, prophages and mobile genetic elements as mobile elements, and other phage-defense systems.
